title: Remux encrypted media without decrypting its samples

definition.title: Remux encrypted media without decrypting its samples
definition.source_excerpt: Container-only adaptation of synthetic application-controlled encrypted samples; preserve every encryption auxiliary record and require authorized destination playback. No decryption bypass.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially changes an eligible file from an expensive/unsupported route to correct native or minimal-transform playback. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
definition.minimum_probe: Prerequisite-only first: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route. If absent, record HOLD_ENV; if present, decide whether the small probe is warranted. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.initial_screen: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used. Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
definition.primary_metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
definition.scope_contract: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
definition.negative_control: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
definition.stop_boundary: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Existing source-grounded definition imported; acceptance criteria must be reviewed before a new run.

prepare.basis: New executable probe and declared workload/controls registered with source/input/runtime evidence.

screen.basis: Ciphertext-preserving remux into one valid CENC fragment now reaches actual browser CENC decryption, visible red output, seek and EOF. Full independent decrypted pixels and ciphertext/IV identity pass; wrong-IV and wrong-key controls detect corruption. Direct-file false-positive EOF and protected canvas limitations retained.

correctness.basis: Owned generated24-frame AVC video only, one key/KID, CENC with explicit IV/subsample records, one fragment. All ciphertext/senc bytes preserved; reconstructed moof-relative saio offsets. Full host independent decrypted pixels equal clear baseline; wrong IV changes output. Normal Chrome MSE CENC pipeline gives visible red screenshot pixel[248,36,0,255],seek0.8,EOF,34reported frames including seek replays; wrong key produces PIPELINE_ERROR_DECODE and no observed frames. Session/MediaKeys/URL/browser cleanup. Canvas readback remains black; no exact browser compositor-pixel proof, arbitrary multitrack/cbcs/key rotation/third-party licenses claim.

performance.basis: Capability-only encrypted-container construction without decrypting samples; no efficiency claim. Correct old direct-file destination does not exist in this test profile, so no forced savings benchmark. All host decryption here is independent owned-key oracle, never candidate remux operation.

results.basis: Actual new execution raw outcomes, controls and scoped interpretation retained.
